decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive play, utilizing efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast for direct damage. Thraben Inspector and Novice Inspector provide card advantage and Makeshift Munitions can turn creatures into additional damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of creatures and burn spells, while also having some removal options like Journey to Nowhere and Demand Answers to control the board.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and counterspells to maintain board control and disrupt opponent's strategy. By consistently deploying flyers like Spellstutter Sprite and Judge's Familiar, alongside efficient removal spells like Snap and Mutagenic Growth, the deck aims to pressure opponents while protecting its own threats. With a variety of card draw options like Of One Mind and Ninja of the Deep Hours, the Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to establish an early advantage and maintain tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countering spells, protecting key creatures with protection spells, and recurring threats through card draw and fetch spells. The deck aims to establish a strong defense using gates and the Guardian of the Guildpact, while also maintaining card advantage with Deep Analysis and Squadron Hawk. The overall strategy is to outlast opponents and grind them down with incremental advantages until victory is achieved. The deck excels in long, grindy games where patience and resource management are key.

The primary focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and efficient burn spells. By using cards like Burning-Tree Emissary and Simian Spirit Guide to generate extra mana and play multiple threats in a single turn, along with powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Abrade, the deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can establish a defense. The inclusion of cards like Trailblazer's Torch and Crimson Fleet Commodore provide additional reach and finishing power to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of Gates and defensive creatures, while also having the ability to draw cards and counter spells. The deck focuses on playing defensively with cards like Prismatic Strands and Lórien Revealed, and using cards like Counterspell and Citadel Gate to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The Gates provide additional mana fixing and the ability to bounce lands back to hand for value. Overall, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a win through card advantage and control.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's plays with a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. The deck aims to maintain board control while efficiently managing resources through cards like Snuff Out, Counterspell, and Deep Analysis. Unexpected Fangs and Thought Scour offer additional flexibility and card advantage, while cards like Gurmag Angler and Murmuring Mystic provide win conditions. Utilizing a combination of disruption and card advantage, this deck seeks to outlast opponents and secure victory through smart plays and effective resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize reanimation spells and combo pieces to quickly get powerful creatures onto the battlefield. By using cards like Exhume, Dread Return, and Deadly Dispute, the player can bring back creatures like Avenging Hunter and Troll of Khazad-dûm from the graveyard for extra value. The deck also includes removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down to control the board while setting up their combo. The inclusion of cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Crypt Rats provides additional utility and options for the player to outmaneuver their opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing walls with high toughness to generate mana and combo off with cards like Freed from the Real and Galvanic Alchemist. The goal is to ramp up quickly with Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement, while filtering through the deck with cards like Winding Way and Lead the Stampede to find the combo pieces. By creating a loop where you can untap your creatures repeatedly, you can generate infinite mana and win the game. The walls also provide protection and stall against aggressive decks until you can assemble your combo.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to utilize cheap creatures and efficient removal spells in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive attacks and burn damage. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, along with efficient creatures like Kor Skyfisher and Glint Hawk, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game. With supporting cards like All That Glitters and Experimental Synthesizer, the deck can grow its threats quickly and close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures, supplemented by burn spells and equipment. The deck aims to control the board early on with small creatures like Novice Inspector and use them to build up to bigger threats like Kor Skyfisher and Glint Hawk. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere to deal with opposing threats. By combining aggression with some control elements, this deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a board of artifact creatures and using cheap spells to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. The key strategy is to efficiently use cards like Thoughtcast and Metallic Rebuke to draw more cards and protect your creatures, while also utilizing cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage to the opponent. By combining artifact creatures with powerful enchantments like All That Glitters, this deck can quickly snowball out of control and overpower opponents in a fast-paced matchup.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through counter spells and removal, while generating value with card draw and creature recursion. The key strategy is to use Ephemerate to repeatedly blink powerful creatures like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas to maintain card advantage and board presence. The deck also includes various utility spells like Skred and Cleansing Wildfire to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By efficiently managing resources and out-valuing the opponent, this deck aims to grind out victories in a methodical and strategic manner.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game by utilizing Counterspells and removal spells like Skred and Cleansing Wildfire. The deck focuses on card advantage and tempo with cards like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas. Ephemerate is used to reuse powerful Enter the Battlefield effects, while cards like Ponder and Brainstorm help with card selection. The deck also includes some creatures like Murmuring Mystic and Kenku Artificer to provide additional threats. Overall, the deck is designed to disrupt opponent's strategies and outvalue them over the course of the game.

The deck focuses on filling the graveyard with creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield using cards like Exhume and Dread Return. By utilizing cards like Gnaw to the Bone and Acorn Harvest, the deck can generate a large number of creatures in the graveyard quickly. The key strategy is to use the reanimation spells to bring back powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Lotleth Giant to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes ramp spells and creature generators to maintain a steady flow of threats on the battlefield.

The central focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing cheap and efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck aims to close out the game as quickly as possible by applying constant pressure and minimizing the opponent's ability to stabilize. This aggressive approach is bolstered by the use of cards that allow for repeatable damage and the ability to go wide on the board to maximize damage output.

The deck focuses on using walls with high toughness to generate mana and protect the player, while also utilizing combos like Freed from the Real and Axebane Guardian to produce large amounts of mana and win the game. The deck also includes ways to dig for combo pieces and return creatures from the graveyard to maintain board presence. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces while setting up a strong defense with walls to outvalue the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with a massive mana advantage.
